hindi: तीन धर्मस्थ, तीन अमात्य, जनपद, सन्धि, संग्रहण, द्रोणमुख, स्थानीय में व्यवहार-सम्बन्धी विषयों को सम्पन्न करें।
english: Three dharmasthas [and] three ministers should carry out legal (vyāvahārika) matters in the jana-pada, sandhi, saṅgrahaṇa, droṇa-mukha and sthānīya.
notes: 'trayas trayo' is read as three dharmasthas and three amātyas (alternative: three of each). The place-list is one dvandva compound; jana-pada-sandhi may instead be one tat-puruṣa 'junction of countries'. saṅgrahaṇa and droṇa-mukha are settlement terms kept as printed; sthānīya as in the glossary (8.4).
lines_deva: धर्मस्थास् त्रयस् त्रयो ऽमात्या जन.पद.सन्धि.सङ्ग्रहण.द्रोण.मुख.स्थानीयेषु व्यावहारिकान् अर्थान् कुर्युः
lines_iast: dharmasthās trayas trayo 'mātyā jana.pada.sandhi.saṅgrahaṇa.droṇa.mukha.sthānīyeṣu vyāvahārikān arthān kuryuḥ

words.gloss: made in concealment, indoors, at night, in forest, by upadhi, in a secluded place

hindi: और छिपाकर, घर के भीतर, रात में, वन में, उपधि से, एकान्त स्थान में किए गए व्यवहारों का वे निषेध करें।
english: They should also reject transactions (vyavahāra) made in concealment, inside the house, at night, in the forest, by upadhi, [or] in a secluded place.
notes: upadhi is kept untranslated (obscure; 'deceit' is a possible sense). The case-sense of the first members is mixed (some locative, upadhi instrumental). upahvara = secluded place (literal). vyavahāra is rendered 'transaction' in units 2-15 and 17 and kept as vyavahāra in the verses 39-40, where it is a technical term. pratiṣedhayeyuḥ is a causative; 'should reject' follows the glossary, 'should have prohibited' is possible. The Hindi leaves out the ca ('also').

words.gloss: of the one who has it done

hindi: करने वाले, करवाने वाले के लिए प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है।
english: For the doer, for the one who has it done: the first fine for rashness.
notes: The predicate is not stated; 'for' is read from the genitives. 'First' is the ordinal pūrva, not explained here.

hindi: श्रोताओं में प्रत्येक के लिए आधे-आधे दण्ड हैं।
english: For the hearers, one by one, [there are] penalties of half each.
notes: Half of what is not stated. pratyardha is read as 'half in each case'. 'Hearers' is literal for śrotṛ; the line does not call them witnesses.

hindi: परन्तु विश्वास करने योग्य लोगों के लिए द्रव्य का हटाया जाना है।
english: But for the trustworthy, [there is] removal of property.
notes: vyapanaya = 'leading away, removal'; the line does not say whether it is confiscation or a penalty. The predicate is not stated.

hindi: परोक्ष में अधिक ऋण का ग्रहण, अथवा अवक्तव्य-कर वाले, छिपे हुए सिद्ध हों।
english: Concealed [transactions]: the taking of an excess debt in absence, or [those] with an unspeakable kara, would be valid.

text_flags.why: possible: visarga missing; 'tirohitāḥ sidhyeyuḥ' are plural, though 'karā' could also be a feminine singular, so this is uncertain

notes: Obscure line. avaktavya-kara is kept literal: avaktavya = 'not to be spoken', kara could be 'tax', 'hand' or 'doing'; no sense is built on it. adhika-ṛṇa-grahaṇa could also be 'taking of debt in excess'. The two cases are read as alternatives (vā). The printed 'karā' is flagged as a possible slip for plural karāḥ (tirohitāḥ is plural).

words.gloss: concerned with inheritance, deposit, upanidhi, marriage
of those who do not go out

hindi: दाय, निक्षेप, उपनिधि, विवाह से सम्बद्ध, घर के भीतर किए गए व्यवहार बाहर न निकलने वाली स्त्रियों के और भ्रमित न हुई चेतना वाले रोगियों के सिद्ध हों।
english: [Transactions] concerned with inheritance, deposit, upanidhi [and] marriage, made inside the house, of women who do not go out and of the sick whose consciousness is unconfused, would be valid.
notes: The ca joins strīṇām aniṣkāsinīnām with vyādhitānām amūḍha-sañjñānām, as rendered. yukta is read as 'concerned with'. upanidhi is kept untranslated (glossary 4.6). 'the sick whose consciousness is unconfused' takes amūḍha-sañjñānām as qualifying vyādhitānām; if the two are separate groups the sense differs.
lines_deva: दाय.निक्षेप.उपनिधि.विवाह.युक्ताः स्त्रीणाम् अनिष्कासिनीनां व्याधितानां च-अमूढ.सञ्ज्ञानाम् अन्तर्.अगार.कृताः सिध्येयुः
lines_iast: dāya.nikṣepa.upanidhi.vivāha.yuktāḥ strīṇām aniṣkāsinīnāṃ vyādhitānāṃ ca-amūḍha.sañjñānām antar.agāra.kṛtāḥ sidhyeyuḥ

words.gloss: concerned with rashness, entry, quarrel, marriage, royal appointment
of those who transact in the early night

hindi: साहस, अनुप्रवेश, कलह, विवाह, राजा की नियुक्ति से सम्बद्ध तथा रात के पूर्व भाग में व्यवहार करने वालों के रात में किए गए सिद्ध हों।
english: [Transactions] concerned with rashness, entry, quarrel, marriage [and] royal appointment, and those made at night of persons who transact in the early part of the night, would be valid.
notes: anupraveśa = 'entering after / intrusion', kept as 'entry'; rāja-niyoga = royal appointment or command (literally 'assignment by the king'). rātri-kṛtāḥ is read with pūrva-rātra-vyavahāriṇām.

words.gloss: in the midst of caravans, cattle-stations, hermitages, hunters, cāraṇas

hindi: सार्थ, व्रज, आश्रम, व्याध, चारण के बीच वनचरों के वन में किए गए सिद्ध हों।
english: In the midst of caravans, cattle-stations, hermitages, hunters [and] cāraṇas, [transactions] of forest-goers made in the forest would be valid.
notes: cāraṇa is kept as a term (glossary 4.1). The compound is read as a dvandva of five groups plus madhya 'in the midst of'; sārtha = caravan, vraja = cattle-station (glossary 9.6). The word 'transactions' is supplied in brackets.

hindi: गूढ़ आजीविका वालों में तथा उपधि से किए गए सिद्ध हों।
english: Among those with secret livelihoods, and [those] made by upadhi, [transactions] would be valid.
notes: upadhi is kept untranslated (obscure). The syntax of ca is unclear: it may join upadhi-kṛtāḥ to the earlier groups rather than to gūḍha-ājīviṣu.

hindi: परस्पर के समवाय में तथा एकान्त स्थान में किए गए सिद्ध हों।
english: In a mutual association, and [those] made in a secluded place, [transactions] would be valid.
notes: mithaḥ-samavāya = 'mutual association/gathering'; it is not clear whether this means a private meeting or a meeting of the two parties. upahvara-kṛta transactions are rejected in unit 2 yet valid here; the line does not resolve this (the ca may mark the exception).

words.gloss: by a slave and a pledged person
by one who has not reached and one who has passed beyond dealing
by the accused, renunciants, nyaṅga, those given to vice

hindi: इससे भिन्न प्रकार से वे सिद्ध न हों; और जो सहारा रखने वालों द्वारा किए गए हों, पिता वाले पुत्र द्वारा, पुत्र वाले पिता द्वारा, कुलरहित भाई द्वारा, अविभक्त भाग वाले छोटे भाई द्वारा, पति वाली और पुत्र वाली स्त्री द्वारा, दास-आहितक द्वारा, जिसने व्यवहार को प्राप्त नहीं किया और जो उसे पार कर चुका, उन दोनों द्वारा, तथा अभिशस्त, प्रव्रजित, न्यङ्ग और व्यसनियों द्वारा; जिन्हें व्यवहार सौंपा गया है उनको छोड़कर।
english: Otherwise than this they would not be valid, and [those] made by persons having a support, by a son who has a father, by a father who has a son, by a brother without family, by a younger [brother] with an undivided share, by a woman who has a husband and a son, by a slave and a pledged person, by one who has not reached and one who has passed beyond dealing (vyavahāra), and by the accused, renunciants, nyaṅga and persons given to vice (vyasana), except [for] those entrusted with transacting.
notes: Many terms are literal and uncertain: apāśraya = refuge/support (the text does not say whose); niṣkula = 'without kula' (alternatively 'separated from the family'); āhitaka = pledged person (glossary ādhāna = pledge); aprāpta-atīta-vyavahāra = not yet reached / already past [the stage of] dealing (age or capacity is not stated); abhiśasta = accused (alternatively cursed/outcast); nyaṅga is kept untranslated (possibly 'maimed'); niṣṛṣṭa = sent out, delegated. 'ataḥ anyathā' = 'otherwise than this' (i.e. than the cases of units 6-11). vyasanin = given to vice (glossary 4.6).
lines_deva: अतो ऽन्यथा न सिध्येयुः, अपाश्रयवद्भिश् च कृताः, पितृमता पुत्रेण, पित्रा पुत्रवता, निष्कुलेन भ्रात्रा, कनिष्ठेन-अविभक्त.अंशेन, पतिमत्या पुत्रवत्या च स्त्रिया, दास.आहितकाभ्याम्, अप्राप्त.अतीत.व्यवहाराभ्याम्, अभिशस्त.प्रव्रजित.न्यङ्ग.व्यसनिभिश् च, अन्यत्र निषृष्ट.व्यवहारेभ्यः
lines_iast: ato 'nyathā na sidhyeyuḥ, apāśrayavadbhiś ca kṛtāḥ, pitṛmatā putreṇa, pitrā putravatā, niṣkulena bhrātrā, kaniṣṭhena-avibhakta.aṃśena, patimatyā putravatyā ca striyā, dāsa.āhitakābhyām, aprāpta.atīta.vyavahārābhyām, abhiśasta.pravrajita.nyaṅga.vyasanibhiś ca, anyatra niṣṛṣṭa.vyavahārebhyaḥ

hindi: वहाँ भी क्रोधित, पीड़ित, मत्त-उन्मत्त अथवा पकड़े हुए व्यक्ति द्वारा किए गए व्यवहार सिद्ध न हों।
english: Even there, transactions made by one angry, afflicted, intoxicated and mad, or seized would not be valid.

text_flags.why: inflected first member inside a compound; the '.' may be a slip for '-' (possible)

notes: The e-text writes 'mattena.unmattena' with the first member inflected; it is read as a dvandva matta-unmatta. avagṛhīta = 'seized' (alternatives: restrained, possessed); the glossary gives 'restrain' for avagrāh (5.6), but the sense here is not fixed. 'Even there' = even among the cases that would otherwise be valid.
lines_deva: तत्र-अपि क्रुद्धेन-आर्तेन मत्तेन.उन्मत्तेन-अवगृहीतेन वा कृता व्यवहारा न सिध्येयुः
lines_iast: tatra-api kruddhena-ārtena mattena.unmattena-avagṛhītena vā kṛtā vyavahārā na sidhyeyuḥ

words.gloss: of doers, those who have it done, hearers

hindi: करने वालों, करवाने वालों, श्रोताओं के लिए अलग-अलग दण्ड जैसे कहे गए हैं।
english: For doers, those who have it done [and] hearers, the penalties [are] separately as stated.
notes: 'as stated' refers back to units 3-4. kārayitṛ is rendered 'instigator' only in the gloss; the literal sense is 'one who has it done' (unit 3).

words.gloss: made with their own means of proof
with form, mark, measure, qualities observed

hindi: किन्तु अपने-अपने वर्ग, स्थान और काल में अपने प्रमाण से किए गए, पूर्ण आचार वाले, शुद्ध स्थान वाले, रूप, लक्षण, माप, गुण देखे हुए सब व्यवहार सिद्ध हों।
english: But all transactions made with their own means of proof, in each one's own class, place and time, complete in procedure, with a pure place, [and] with form, mark, measure and qualities observed, would be valid.
notes: karaṇa follows the glossary (sva-karaṇa = means of proof); in units 16-17 karaṇa is kept untranslated because the sense (document / time-division) is not fixed. varga = class/group (literal; the line does not say what kind). dṛṣṭa-rūpa-lakṣaṇa-pramāṇa-guṇa is read 'whose form, mark, measure and qualities have been seen'. 'śuddha-deśa' may mean 'a clean/valid place'.
lines_deva: स्वे स्वे तु वर्गे देशे काले च स्व.करण.कृताः सम्पूर्ण.आचाराः शुद्ध.देशा दृष्ट.रूप.लक्षण.प्रमाण.गुणाः सर्व.व्यवहाराः सिध्येयुः
lines_iast: sve sve tu varge deśe kāle ca sva.karaṇa.kṛtāḥ sampūrṇa.ācārāḥ śuddha.deśā dṛṣṭa.rūpa.lakṣaṇa.pramāṇa.guṇāḥ sarva.vyavahārāḥ sidhyeyuḥ

hindi: और इनमें अन्तिम करण आदेश और बन्धक को छोड़कर विश्वसनीय है। — यह व्यवहार की स्थापना है।
english: And the last of these karaṇa [is] trustworthy, excluding ādeśa and pledge. — Such is the laying down of vyavahāra.

text_flags.why: embedded verse number and bars inside the text; not Sanskrit words

notes: GROUPING: the printed '| 16 |' is an embedded verse number plus separators inside the unit; the closing label 'iti vyavahāra-sthāpanā' (section title) follows it and belongs to the section, not to the sentence. karaṇa kept untranslated (the glossary gives 'means of proof' for sva-karaṇa; here also possibly 'document'). ādeśa is kept untranslated (obscure); ādhi = pledge (glossary 4.1). vyavahāra-sthāpanā: sthāpanā = 'establishing, laying down'; the title may refer to the whole opening section.
lines_deva: पश्चिमं च-एषां करणम् आदेश.आधिवर्जं श्रद्धेयम् । १६ । इति व्यवहार.स्थापना
lines_iast: paścimaṃ ca-eṣāṃ karaṇam ādeśa.ādhivarjaṃ śraddheyam | 16 | iti vyavahāra.sthāpanā

words.gloss: of the vedaka and the āvedaka
of the two whose state is done, capable
region, village, caste, gotra, name, actions
in the order of the matter

hindi: वर्ष, ऋतु, मास, पक्ष, दिवस, करण, अधिकरण, ऋण तथा वेदक और आवेदक के, जिनकी अवस्था कृत-समर्थ है, देश, ग्राम, जाति, गोत्र, नाम, कर्मों को लिखकर वादी और प्रतिवादी के प्रश्नों को वस्तु के क्रम से दर्ज करे।
english: Having written down the year, season, month, fortnight, day, karaṇa, adhikaraṇa, [and] debt, and the regions, villages, castes, gotras, names [and] actions of the vedaka and the āvedaka, [in their] done [and] capable states, he should enter the questions of plaintiff and defendant in the order of the matter.
notes: vedaka-āvedaka are kept as printed: vedaka = 'one who makes known', āvedaka = 'one who reports', their roles are not stated (not read as plaintiff/defendant here). kṛta-samartha-avasthayoḥ is obscure (literally 'of the two whose state is done, capable'); no sense is built on it. karaṇa here is probably the time-division (after divasa), not 'means of proof' of unit 15; adhikaraṇa = court/seat (literal, doubtful). vādin/prativādin = plaintiff/defendant (literally 'speaker' and 'counter-speaker'). karma 'actions' may mean occupation. niveśayet is a causative: 'should have entered'; the subject is not stated. Hindi 'दर्ज करे' carries the sense 'enter'.
lines_deva: संवत्सरम् ऋतुं मासं पक्षं दिवसं करणम् अधिकरणम् ऋणं वेदक.आवेदकयोः कृत.समर्थ.अवस्थयोर् देश.ग्राम.जाति.गोत्र.नाम.कर्माणि च-अभिलिख्य वादि.प्रतिवादि.प्रश्नान् अर्थ.आनुपूर्व्या निवेशयेत्
lines_iast: saṃvatsaram ṛtuṃ māsaṃ pakṣaṃ divasaṃ karaṇam adhikaraṇam ṛṇaṃ vedaka.āvedakayoḥ kṛta.samartha.avasthayor deśa.grāma.jāti.gotra.nāma.karmāṇi ca-abhilikhya vādi.prativādi.praśnān artha.ānupūrvyā niveśayet

hindi: और दर्ज किए हुओं का निरीक्षण करे।
english: And he should examine the entered [ones].
notes: niviṣṭān is masculine plural and agrees with praśnān of unit 17, so 'questions' is understood; the noun is not repeated.

hindi: बँधे हुए वाद को छोड़कर दूसरे वाद में चला जाता है; पहले कहे हुए को बाद के विषय से नहीं जोड़ता; दूसरे के वचन को, जो पकड़ने योग्य नहीं, पकड़कर टिका रहता है; प्रतिज्ञा करके “स्थान बताओ” ऐसा कहे जाने पर नहीं बताता; हीन स्थान या अदेश बताता है; बताए गए स्थान से भिन्न स्थान प्रस्तुत करता है; स्थान के प्रस्तुत होने पर विषय के कथन को “ऐसा नहीं” कहकर अस्वीकार करता है; साक्षियों द्वारा निश्चित किए हुए को नहीं चाहता; जिस स्थान पर बात करना मना है वहाँ साक्षियों से एकान्त में बात करता है। — ये परा-उक्त होने के कारण हैं।
english: Having abandoned a fixed plea, he passes over to another plea; he does not join what was stated before with the later matter; having seized upon the other's statement that is not to be seized upon, he stands [by it]; having asserted [a claim] and being told “Specify the place”, he does not specify; he specifies a deficient place or a non-place; he brings forward a place other than the specified place; when the place is presented, he denies the statement of the matter [saying] “Not so”; he does not wish [to accept] what was ascertained by witnesses; in a place where talking is not allowed he converses privately with witnesses. — Such are the grounds of being parā-ukta.
notes: The list of faults of a litigant; the subject (he) is not named. Doubtful: anabhigrāhyam abhigrāhya-avatiṣṭhate (literal: having seized upon what is not to be seized upon, he stands; alternative: 'persists after challenging the unchallengeable'); apavyayate (taken as 'denies', from apa-vi-√i or apa-vyay, root uncertain); adeśa 'non-place' (kept literal); asambhāṣye deśe = a place where talking is not permitted (the line does not say why). deśa is rendered 'place' throughout. The Hindi uses quotation marks and कहकर for the iti of the quoted words only; the closing 'iti' of the last clause is a summing-up label ('such are'). parā-ukta is kept untranslated (parā-√vac 'declared defeated' is not certain). Hindi परा-उक्त keeps the form.
lines_deva: निबद्धं वादम् उत्सृज्य-अन्यं वादं सङ्क्रामति, पूर्व.उक्तं पश्चिमेन-अर्थेन न-अभिसन्धत्ते, पर.वाक्यम् अनभिग्राह्यम् अभिग्राह्य-अवतिष्ठते, प्रतिज्ञाय देशं निर्दिश-इत्य् उक्ते न निर्दिशति, हीन.देशम् अदेशं वा निर्दिशति, निर्दिष्टाद् देशाद् अन्यं देशम् उपस्थापयति, उपस्थिते देशे ऽर्थ.वचनं न-एवम् इत्य् अपव्ययते, साक्षिभिर् अवधृतं न-इच्छति, असम्भाष्ये देशे साक्षिभिर् मिथः सम्भाषते, इति परा.उक्त.हेतवः
lines_iast: nibaddhaṃ vādam utsṛjya-anyaṃ vādaṃ saṅkrāmati, pūrva.uktaṃ paścimena-arthena na-abhisandhatte, para.vākyam anabhigrāhyam abhigrāhya-avatiṣṭhate, pratijñāya deśaṃ nirdiśa-ity ukte na nirdiśati, hīna.deśam adeśaṃ vā nirdiśati, nirdiṣṭād deśād anyaṃ deśam upasthāpayati, upasthite deśe 'rtha.vacanaṃ na-evam ity apavyayate, sākṣibhir avadhṛtaṃ na-icchati, asambhāṣye deśe sākṣibhir mithaḥ sambhāṣate, iti parā.ukta.hetavaḥ

hindi: परा-उक्त का दण्ड पाँच बन्ध वाला है।
english: The penalty for the parā-ukta [is] of five bandhas.
notes: parā-ukta kept untranslated (see unit 19). bandha is obscure and kept as printed (it may be a fraction or part, the text does not say). The line may equally be read 'five-bandha penalty'.

words.gloss: penalty for one who pleads himself

hindi: स्वयं कहने वाले का दण्ड दस बन्ध वाला है।
english: The penalty for the self-pleader [is] of ten bandhas.
notes: svayaṃ-vādin = 'one who himself speaks'; it may mean one who admits or one who pleads for himself, not decided. bandha as in unit 20.

hindi: पुरुषों की मज़दूरी आठवाँ भाग है।
english: The wages of men [are] an eighth part.
notes: Eighth part of what is not stated; puruṣa-bhṛti may be 'hire of men' or 'support of men'.

hindi: मार्ग में भोजन मूल्य के भेद के अनुसार है।
english: Food on the road [is] according to the difference of value.
notes: pathi is locative ('on the road'); argha = price/value. The line is elliptical; the relation to unit 22 is not stated.

hindi: जिसे नियन्त्रित किया जाना है, वह उन दोनों को दे।
english: The one to be restrained should give both of those.
notes: 'both' refers to the two items of units 22-23 (wages and food). niyamya is gerundive of ni-√yam 'to be restrained'; 'to be compelled' is an alternative.

hindi: अभियुक्त प्रत्यभियोग न करे, कलह, साहस, सार्थ-समवाय को छोड़कर।
english: The accused should not counter-charge, except [in cases of] quarrel, rashness [and] caravan-association.
notes: sārtha-samavāya may be one term (caravan-association) or the items may be kalaha, sāhasa and sārtha, with samavāya common to all; the plural -ebhyaḥ is read as three or two cases. abhiyukta = one against whom a charge is brought.

hindi: और अभियुक्त के विषय में अभियोग नहीं है।
english: And in the case of the accused there is no charge.

text_flags.why: possible: expected nominative abhiyogaḥ (+ 'sti), the verb asti needs a subject

notes: The printed 'abhiyoge' is locative; the sentence needs a subject, so the nominative abhiyogaḥ is suggested (possible). If both are locatives the sense would be 'there is not [anything] in the charge against the charged'. 'Of the accused' may mean the accused cannot himself be charged.

hindi: यदि अभियोक्ता उत्तर पाने पर उसी दिन उत्तर न दे, तो वह परा-उक्त होगा।
english: If the charger, when answered, does not reply on that very day, he would be parā-ukta.
notes: abhiyoktā is the one who brings the charge (here the plaintiff); 'pratyuktaḥ' = answered to (the accused has replied). The apodosis is joined without 'tarhi'.
lines_deva: अभियोक्ता चेत् प्रत्युक्तस् तद्.अहर् एव न प्रतिब्रूयात् परा.उक्तः स्यात्
lines_iast: abhiyoktā cet pratyuktas tad.ahar eva na pratibrūyāt parā.uktaḥ syāt

words.gloss: one by whom the decision of the matter has been made

hindi: क्योंकि जिसने कार्य का निश्चय कर लिया है वह अभियोक्ता है, अभियुक्त नहीं।
english: For the charger [is] one by whom the decision of the matter has been made, not the accused.
notes: kārya = matter/case. The line gives the reason for unit 27.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-prati-√brū

hindi: उत्तर न देने वाले के लिए “तीन रात, सात रात”।
english: For him who does not reply: “three nights, seven nights”.
notes: Elliptical: the two periods are given as a quoted alternative (probably the two views on the time allowed); the line does not say whose views. The closing iti is rendered by the quotation marks only.

words.gloss: with three paṇas as the lower [limit]
with twelve paṇas as the upper [limit]

hindi: इसके बाद तीन पण निम्न सीमा वाला, बारह पण उच्च सीमा वाला दण्ड करे।
english: After this he should impose a penalty with three paṇas as the lower [limit] and twelve paṇas as the upper.
notes: avara-ardhya is obscure; ardhya is not given a firm sense (lower limit / valued / half). 'limit' is supplied from the contrast avara / para. 'daṇḍam kuryāt' is literally 'should make a penalty'. paṇa is kept as a unit name (glossary 4.1).
lines_deva: अत ऊर्ध्वं त्रि.पण.अवर.अर्ध्यं द्वादश.पण.परं दण्डं कुर्यात्
lines_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ tri.paṇa.avara.ardhyaṃ dvādaśa.paṇa.paraṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryāt

hindi: तीन पक्ष के बाद उत्तर न देने वाले का परा-उक्त-दण्ड करके, उसके जो द्रव्य हों, उनमें से अभियोक्ता को सौंप दे, जीविका के उपकरणों को छोड़कर।
english: After three fortnights, [in the case] of one who does not reply, having imposed the parā-ukta penalty, he should hand over to the charger, from whatever properties he may have, except the implements of livelihood.
notes: 'tri-pakṣāt ūrdhvam' = after three fortnights (alternatively 'after the third fortnight'). 'from whatever properties' follows tataḥ (ablative of source). pratipādayet is a causative (literally 'cause to reach'); 'hand over' follows the sense. vṛtti = livelihood, upakaraṇa = implement; the compound is read as a tat-puruṣa.
lines_deva: त्रि.पक्षाद् ऊर्ध्वम् अप्रतिब्रुवतः परा.उक्त.दण्डं कृत्वा यान्य् अस्य द्रव्याणि स्युस् ततो ऽभियोक्तारं प्रतिपादयेद्, अन्यत्र वृत्त्य्.उपकरणेभ्यः
lines_iast: tri.pakṣād ūrdhvam apratibruvataḥ parā.ukta.daṇḍaṃ kṛtvā yāny asya dravyāṇi syus tato 'bhiyoktāraṃ pratipādayed, anyatra vṛtty.upakaraṇebhyaḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. nis-√pat

hindi: भाग निकलने वाले अभियुक्त के लिए वही करे।
english: He should do that very [thing] for the accused who runs away.
notes: 'that' refers back to units 30-31 (the penalty and handing over); the text does not say so. niṣpatataḥ = 'flying out, running away'.

words.gloss: having the same time as the flight

hindi: अभियोक्ता का परा-उक्त होने का भाव उसके भाग निकलने के समय के समान है।
english: For the charger, the state of being parā-ukta [is] of the same time as the flight.
notes: i.e. simultaneous with the charger's running away; the line does not say what follows. niṣpāta = flying out, flight.

hindi: मृतक अथवा व्यसनी का साक्षी-वचन सार-रहित है।
english: The statement of a witness, [whether] of the deceased or of one given to vice (vyasana), [is] without substance.
notes: The construction is ambiguous: pretasya vyasaninaḥ vā may qualify the witness ('a witness who is dead or given to vice') or the party for whom the witness speaks; rendered literally as genitives. sāra = substance/strength; 'asāram' = of no weight. preta = the deceased (glossary 5.3).

hindi: अभियोक्ता दण्ड देकर कर्म करवाए।
english: The charger, having paid the penalty, should have work done.
notes: karma is rendered 'work' (glossary 5.3: karma = work of servants/officials) because the line seems to speak of labour; the glossary default 'action' is also possible. Who does the work, and for whom, is not stated; kārayet is a causative ('should have done'). The subject of kārayet is taken to be the same charger.

hindi: अथवा वह इच्छानुसार बन्धक रखवाए।
english: Or he should have a pledge put in, at will.
notes: The printed 'sa kāmam' may be one word sakāmam ('willingly, at will'); the meaning is nearly the same either way. 'He' is not identified. praveśayet is literally 'cause to enter' (pledge placed with the other party).

hindi: अथवा रक्षोघ्न-रक्षित को कर्म के द्वारा सौंप दे, ब्राह्मण को छोड़कर।
english: Or he should hand over, by work, [one] guarded by rakṣoghna, except [in the case of] a brāhmaṇa.
notes: rakṣoghna-rakṣita is obscure: rakṣoghna is literally 'demon-slaying' (it may be a rite, a spell or a guard); no sense is built on it. karmaṇā = 'by work/action', see unit 35. 'in the case of' is supplied for the ablative with anyatra; the object (one guarded) is unnamed.
lines_deva: रक्षोघ्न.रक्षितं वा कर्मणा प्रतिपादयेद्, अन्यत्र ब्राह्मणात्
lines_iast: rakṣoghna.rakṣitaṃ vā karmaṇā pratipādayed, anyatra brāhmaṇāt

words.gloss: of [the world] with four varṇas and āśramas

hindi: चार वर्ण-आश्रमों वाले लोक के आचार की रक्षा करने से यह राजा, सब धर्मों के नष्ट होते समय, धर्म का प्रवर्तक है।
english: Because of protecting the conduct of the world of the four varṇas and āśramas, this king [is] the promoter of dharma, all the dharmas perishing.
notes: The genitive naśyatām sarva-dharmāṇām is read as a genitive absolute ('while all dharmas are perishing'); 'ayam' is read with rājā of the second line. catur-varṇa-āśrama is one bahuvrīhi qualifying loka. ācāra-rakṣaṇāt = 'from protecting conduct' (the line does not say what conduct). 'dharma-pravartakaḥ' = one who sets dharma in motion.

hindi: धर्म और व्यवहार, चरित्र, राज-शासन। विवाद का विषय चार पैरों वाला है; अन्तिम पूर्व का बाधक है।
english: Dharma and vyavahāra, caritra, royal edict: the matter of dispute [is] four-footed; the last overrides the earlier.
notes: vyavahāra, caritra are kept as terms (units 40, 41 define them); in this verse vyavahāra is a technical term, not 'transaction'. vivāda-artha may be 'the purpose of a dispute' (a dispute rests on four feet) rather than 'matter of a dispute'. 'the last overrides the earlier' = each later of the four sets aside the earlier. pūrva-bādhaka = 'that which sets aside (obstructs) the earlier'.
lines_deva: धर्मश् च व्यवहारश् च चरित्रं राज.शासनम्
lines_iast: dharmaś ca vyavahāraś ca caritraṃ rāja.śāsanam

hindi: उनमें धर्म सत्य में स्थित है; व्यवहार तो साक्षियों में; चरित्र पुरुषों के संग्रह में; किन्तु राजाओं की आज्ञा शासन है।
english: Among these, dharma [is] established in truth; vyavahāra, however, [is] in witnesses; caritra [is] in the collection of men; but the command of kings [is] the edict.
notes: saṅgraha = collection / holding together; 'in the collection of men' is literal (it may mean in the usage or consensus of people). The supplied copula is bracketed. The tu in line 1 is rendered 'however'; the tu of line 2 'but'.
lines_deva: तत्र सत्ये स्थितो धर्मो व्यवहारस् तु साक्षिषु
चरित्रं सङ्ग्रहे पुंसां राज्ञाम् आज्ञा तु शासनम्
lines_iast: tatra satye sthito dharmo vyavahāras tu sākṣiṣu
caritraṃ saṅgrahe puṃsāṃ rājñām ājñā tu śāsanam

hindi: प्रजा की धर्म से रक्षा करने वाले राजा का स्व-धर्म स्वर्ग के लिए है; रक्षा न करने वाले अथवा क्षेप करने वाले के लिए मिथ्या-दण्ड है, यह इससे भिन्न है।
english: For the king who protects the subjects by dharma, [his] own dharma [is] for heaven; for one who does not protect, or one who casts, [there is] false penalty, [which is] otherwise than this.
notes: Elliptical and doubtful. kṣeptṛ (√kṣip) literally 'one who throws/casts' (other senses: one who abuses, one who punishes wrongly); kept literal. 'mithyā-daṇḍam ataḥ anyathā' may mean 'a false penalty [leads to] something other than this [heaven]'; no destination is stated. The line may also be read as 'the king's own dharma leads to heaven for a protector; otherwise [for] a non-protector or kṣeptṛ — false punishment'.
lines_deva: राज्ञः स्व.धर्मः स्वर्गाय प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षितुः
अरक्षितुर् वा क्षेप्तुर् वा मिथ्या.दण्डम् अतो ऽन्यथा
lines_iast: rājñaḥ sva.dharmaḥ svargāya prajā dharmeṇa rakṣituḥ
arakṣitur vā kṣeptur vā mithyā.daṇḍam ato 'nyathā

hindi: क्योंकि दण्ड केवल परलोक की और इस लोक की रक्षा करता है, राजा द्वारा पुत्र पर और शत्रु पर दोष के अनुसार समान रूप से धारण किया गया।
english: For the penalty (daṇḍa) alone protects the other world and this one, [when] held equally by the king on a son and on an enemy according to the fault.
notes: daṇḍa is rendered 'penalty' (glossary); 'rod, staff, punishment' are alternatives. dhṛta = 'held, borne, imposed'. 'other world and this' is read from 'lokam param ca imam ca' (loka is singular, shared by both). The supplied [when] reads the second line as a participial phrase.
lines_deva: दण्डो हि केवलो लोकं परं च-इमं च रक्षति
राज्ञा पुत्रे च शत्रौ च यथा.दोषं समं धृतः
lines_iast: daṇḍo hi kevalo lokaṃ paraṃ ca-imaṃ ca rakṣati
rājñā putre ca śatrau ca yathā.doṣaṃ samaṃ dhṛtaḥ

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. anu-√śās

hindi: क्योंकि धर्म, व्यवहार, संस्था और चौथे न्याय से शासन करता हुआ चार अन्तों वाली पृथ्वी को जीते।
english: For [one] governing by dharma, vyavahāra, saṃsthā and, fourth, nyāya, would conquer the four-ended earth.

text_flags.why: possible: space misplaced; anuśāsat + hi gives anuśāsad dhi

notes: The first word is printed with a doubled d; the correct form is anuśāsat + hi, i.e. anuśāsad dhi with the space moved (possible). The particle vā ('or') after catur-antām is left out of the translation (it may be emphatic: 'even the four-ended earth'); the subject (the king) is not named in the line. saṃsthā is kept untranslated (see unit 44; the glossary 4.6 keeps it untranslated). nyāya is kept (reasoned rule). catur-anta = 'having four ends' (the four quarters); the line does not say 'oceans'.
lines_deva: न्यायेन च चतुर्थेन चतुर्.अन्तां वा महीं जयेत्
lines_iast: nyāyena ca caturthena catur.antāṃ vā mahīṃ jayet

hindi: जो संस्था धर्मशास्त्र से है, अथवा व्यवहार-सम्बन्धी शास्त्र, जिस विषय में विरोध करे, उस विषय का धर्म से निर्णय करे।
english: The saṃsthā which [is stated] by the dharma treatise, or the treatise relating to vyavahāra: in whatever matter it should conflict, he should decide the matter by dharma.
notes: The singular virudhyeta is read for both saṃsthā and śāstra. 'dharmeṇa' = by dharma (not 'by the treatise'); the line leaves open what 'conflict' is with. saṃsthā kept as in unit 43 (the glossary 4.6 keeps it untranslated).
lines_deva: संस्था या धर्म.शास्त्रेण शास्त्रं वा व्यावहारिकम्
lines_iast: saṃsthā yā dharma.śāstreṇa śāstraṃ vā vyāvahārikam

hindi: यदि शास्त्र धर्म के विषय में किसी न्याय से विरोध करे, तो वहाँ न्याय प्रमाण हो, क्योंकि वहाँ पाठ नष्ट हो जाता है।
english: Should a treatise conflict with some nyāya in a matter of dharma, there nyāya would be the authority, for there the text is lost.
notes: kenacit is read as 'in some [way]' (instrumental, adverbial); it could also qualify nyāyena ('with some nyāya'), which is how it is rendered. pāṭha = reading, recitation, text; 'is lost' (naśyati) = perishes. 'conflict' (vipratipad) can also be 'differ'.
lines_deva: न्यायस् तत्र प्रमाणं स्यात् तत्र पाठो हि नश्यति
lines_iast: nyāyas tatra pramāṇaṃ syāt tatra pāṭho hi naśyati

words.gloss: of own side and other side

hindi: देखा हुआ दोष, स्वयं का कथन, अपने पक्ष और दूसरे पक्ष का; प्रश्न की सरलता, हेतु और शपथ अर्थ के साधक हैं।
english: A fault observed, one's own statement, of own side and other side; straightforwardness of questioning, reason and oath [are] establishers of the matter.
notes: Elliptical: line 1 gives items with no verb; 'artha-sādhakaḥ' is singular and probably governs both lines (the means of establishing the matter). anuyoga is rendered 'questioning' (glossary 4.7/4.8); in 5.4 it is 'instruction'. svayaṃ-vāda = one's own statement (admission is a possible sense). hetu = reason / ground.

words.gloss: in contradiction of the earlier and later matter
in the ground of what the witness is to say
from the hand of the cāra

hindi: पहले और बाद के विषय के विरोध में, साक्षी के वक्तव्य के कारण में, और चार के हाथ से भाग निकलने में पराजय घोषित की जानी चाहिए।
english: In contradiction of the earlier and later matter, in the ground of what the witness is to say, and in running away from the hand of the cāra, defeat is to be declared.
notes: sākṣi-vaktavya-kāraṇa is obscure (kāraṇa = cause, ground, case); cāra-hasta kept literal (cāra may be spy, guard or prison; 'hand' may mean custody). pradeṣṭavyaḥ is read as 'to be declared / assigned'. The line sums up the grounds of unit 19.
